title: Use the backend's conversation system
description:
The backend defines endpoints to use for conversation flows.
They provide ways for a client to start a flow and be given exact instructions as to what to present to the user and what path the user can take. This app needs to remain dumb and rely on the backend for controlling the conversation flows.

All the information about the backend endpoints is both in the `swagger.json` as well as the generated `src/generated/backend/services/ConversationsService.ts` and the models `src/generated/backend/models/ConversationErrorDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ConversationPromptDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ConversationResponseDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/ConversationSuccessDto.ts`, `src/generated/backend/models/HandleInputDto.ts` , `src/generated/backend/models/StartFlowDto.ts`,
`src/generated/backend/models/PromptFieldDto.ts`,
`src/generated/backend/models/PromptOptionDto.ts` and
 `src/generated/backend/models/MessageDto.ts` .

As always make sure you adhere to `docs/CODE_STANDARD.md` and `docs/TESTING.md` .
